messages:
pagerbot: [INCIDENT] sev2 - High error rate and crashloops in eu-central-1 serving tier. Symptoms: repeated CUDA OOMs, container CrashLoopBackOff, increased 429 and 502 on /v1/chat. Autoscaler shows oscillating scale events (scale-up then immediate scale-down) in last 8m. Paging @eng-runtime-ken @sre-olivia @infra-ops

maya: I'm on it. Seeing a burst of pod restarts on node gpu-euc-7, restartCount=8 for inference-eu-12. Kernel logs show 'CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY' then process SIGABRT.

eng-runtime-ken: quick logs:
```
[2026-03-15T09:12:01Z] model-serving: alloc 5.1G failed on GPU 0 - CUDA OOM
[2026-03-15T09:12:02Z] runtime: terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
```
Likely caused by cache warm + immediate traffic routing to new pods. Autoscaler policy is aggressive (scaleDownDelay 20s).

sre-olivia: Observing autoscale graph: replicas 12 -> 24 -> 10 in ~7m. That's thrash. Each new pod receives 100% traffic at start due to LB weight config. Recommend setting newPodTraffic=5% and bump stabilizationWindow to 180s.

infra-ops: Applying quick patch: `kubectl patch hpa serving-hpa -p '{"spec":{"behavior":{"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":180}}}}'`
Also setting LB weight for new pods to 0.05 via service mesh. Pushing now.

maya: Applying node-level mitigation: cordon gpu-euc-7 and drain non-critical workloads. We still have 9 healthy nodes.

cs-rahul: Customer impact: two customers (ad-insights corp id 9921, chatbot-ops id 332) reported degraded responses and 502 errors. Notified both with ETA 30m.

oncall-tess: Handoff in 10. Can you post a short status for me to pick up? Also include whether customers are still impacted.

eng-runtime-ken: Status: mitigations in flight - stabilizationWindow=180s, newPodTraffic=0.05, cordoned gpu-euc-7, temporarily reverted rollout of model 13B-quant-v3 -> rolling back to 13B-quant-v1 which has lower mem. Observed crashloops dropping after ~3 minutes. Error rate down from 9.4% -> 2.1%.

support-bot: Auto-note: incident severity reduced to sev3 after mitigations. Logged event_id=inc-1801002345 for audit.

maya: Additional temp change: disabled eager-kv-preload on that model to avoid double allocation at startup. Patch applied to runtime config: `kv_preload: false` on model 13B-quant.

infra-ops: We're also increasing pod memory headroom as an emergency safeguard: resourceRequests updated +10% for the affected deployment. This will reduce density but prevent immediate OOMs.

eng-runtime-ken: Long term items I'm capturing: 1) implement gradual traffic ramp for new pods (0->100% over configurable window), 2) add memory headroom guardrail check in CI, 3) pre-warm KV cache for canaries, 4) prefer node scale (add nodes) vs aggressive pod churn for this workload.

cs-rahul: Updated customers: both said they'd monitor but appreciate the heads-up. No requests for credits yet.

oncall-tess: Taking watch. Quick runbook note for handoff: monitor OOM counts, pod restarts, autoscaler events, and customer error rate dash. If OOMs > 1% for 10m, escalate to on-call + runtime lead.

sre-olivia: Also recommend adding a circuit-breaker: if OOMs spike, immediately set HPA maxReplicas = currentReplicas and block new rollouts.

maya: Observed a node flap earlier that may have contributed: gpu-euc-4 briefly lost heartbeats from kubelet and evicted pods which increased load on remaining nodes. Raising IR ticket for node health.

infra-ops: Node issue looked like transient NIC firmware bug; scheduling a maintenance window for patching tonight. Will put a note in incidents/maintenance.

eng-runtime-ken: For the postmortem I'll gather: pod-level mem profiles during warmup, autoscale event timeline, LB weight config at time of incident, and model memory regression data.

oncall-tess: Acknowledged. Will monitor metrics and customer channels for 2h. Leaving note: if errors rebound, revert memory headroom change and re-open cordon.

pagerbot: INCIDENT UPDATE - mitigations applied, stability improving. severity -> sev3. Postmortem owner: @eng-runtime-ken. Next steps: retro and long-term fixes tracking.

cs-rahul: I'll follow up with customers in 1h with a summary. Thanks all. :heart:

eng-runtime-ken: Thanks team. Closing the active paging loop; keeping watch window open until 11:30 UTC.

oncall-tess: Handoff complete.

support-bot: Closing note: thread archived to incidents/1801002345 for records.
